description: List all scenarios defined in the network, including their run status and descriptions. By default the 'Actual' scenario is excluded. Set include_actual=true when the user asks about actuals data or wants to compare actuals against other scenarios. Pass changes_for (a scenario id or name) for what that scenario changes: every input it sets, with the base value beside it; with against (another scenario), where the two differ instead.

changes_for.description: A scenario id or name: list what it changes instead.

include_actual.description: If true, include the 'Actual' scenario. Default is false.

name: list_scenarios
